name: KL Local Plan 2040 (RKL2040)
status_detail: Upcoming · gazetted planning framework; implementation phase
summary: The Kuala Lumpur Local Plan 2040 (Pelan Tempatan Kuala Lumpur 2040), the statutory land-use plan guiding the city to 2040. Published by DBKL after public exhibition and review; the accompanying Structure Plan (PSKL2040) proposes a southward expansion of the CBD of over 50 percent, centred on the corridor from KLCC toward Bandar Malaysia.

scale.label: Key proposal
scale.value: CBD southward expansion >50% (KLCC toward Bandar Malaysia)

why_it_matters: The single document that decides what can be built where in KL for the next 15 years. Its CBD-south thesis links almost every big project on this map: Bandar Malaysia, Merdeka 118, the rail interchanges.
questions_to_follow: Which parcels get rezoning objections resolved, and where do height limits land?
Does the southward CBD expansion survive changes in city administration?
location_precision: City-wide policy record. Marker at city centre for map anchoring only.

sources.title: KL Structure Plan 2040 and KL Local Plan 2040

history.event: Draft exhibited for public review; objections and revisions follow.
Plan gazetted; court challenges to specific rezonings reported.
